summary_1line: Arjuna shields Sikhandin and relentlessly disarms Bhishma, who resolves to accept death as celestial signs appear while the armies converge around them.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma stands blazing amid encircling warriors like the fire of doomsday while arrows bristle from his armor on every side.
Arjuna places Sikhandin before him on the chariot and cuts Bhishma’s bow apart as a storm of arrows streaks between them.
Celestial flowers fall from the sky and winds blow softly as unseen sages approve Bhishma’s decision to welcome death in battle.
